Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.behaviour

Enum Class Provenance.Source

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Provenance.Source>
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.behaviour.Provenance.Source
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Provenance.Source>, Constable
Enclosing class:
Provenance
public static enum Provenance.Source extends Enum<Provenance.Source>
The kinds of sources, strongest first: this is the order Behaviour picks a value in.

A component the user set (USER) beats everything. Otherwise a vanilla value is the first of: Paletter's own capture of exactly the version asked for (NATIVE, SCRIPT_API, BDS_PROBE), then what BDS sends clients (WIRE), then the newest capture covering the state, which is a third-party dump (CLOUDBURST_DATA before ALLAY_DATA) or an older version's capture; the sources it beats only cross-check it. A custom block or item that does not set a value gets what Paletter sends for it (WIRE), else BDS_DEFAULT, else UNKNOWN_DEFAULT.

Since:
0.1.0

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ALLAY_DATA
    AllayMC/Allay data/ (MIT), the raw Endstone DevTools dump of BDS; third party.
    BDS_DEFAULT
    The value BDS uses for a custom block or item that does not set the component, captured from BDS.
    BDS_PROBE
    Experiments on BDS (bodies pushed into blocks, light, explosions, fire), run by Paletter's behaviour-probe.
    CLOUDBURST_DATA
    CloudburstMC/Data (Apache-2.0), a native BDS dump; third party, and it post-processes some values.
    NATIVE
    BDS internals, read by a native mod (LeviLamina).
    SCRIPT_API
    BDS Script API, captured by Paletter's tools.
    UNKNOWN_DEFAULT
    The BDS default of a custom block or item is not known (not captured yet); there is no value.
    USER
    A component the user set on custom content (or on an override of a vanilla item).
    WIRE
    What BDS sends clients: the component data of vanilla items and data driven blocks.
